method: Targeted technical literature review: ten primary standards and original open documentation; ranked by relevance to measurements, costing, provenance, workflow. Not an exhaustive systematic search.

references.title: NRM 2 — Detailed measurement for building works
references.edition: October 2021; reissued as practice information October 2022
references.appliesTo: Trade-specific measurement conventions, quantity rules, description and unit discipline
references.boundary: Not a Nepal statutory standard; project contract measurement rules and local codes prevail.

references.title: NRM 1 — Order of cost estimating and cost planning
references.appliesTo: Separate early cost plans, element/group summaries, allowances, exclusions and AOC-like presentation
references.boundary: NRM grouping does not prescribe this project's approved tax or contingency amounts.

references.title: Guide to Cost Estimate Classification Systems
references.edition: Professional Guidance Document No. 01; revision August 29, 2022
references.appliesTo: Classify maturity of a price/estimate rather than presenting tentative assumptions as tender-ready
references.boundary: The exact AACE estimate class requires definition-maturity evidence, not arbitrary labels.

references.title: Industry Foundation Classes (IFC), version 4.3
references.appliesTo: Vendor-neutral model identifiers, geometry lineage and model-backed quantity evidence
references.boundary: IFC quantities require independent quantity/method validation before financial admission.

references.title: IfcOpenShell cost and quantity schedule API
references.appliesTo: Interoperable BIM cost items, quantities, cost schedules and formulas; coordinate with JP CAD
references.boundary: Implementation reference, not itself an approved construction rate or design certification.

references.title: Quarto — reproducible scientific and technical publishing
references.appliesTo: Preferred flexible .qmd format for irregular calculations, formulas, methods, illustrations and HTML/PDF outputs
references.boundary: Executable cells must be run only inside controlled workflows; never treat private notebooks as public site inputs.

references.title: The Jupyter Notebook Format (nbformat)
references.appliesTo: Alternative .ipynb format when exploratory calculations need narrative plus code and rich outputs
references.boundary: Notebook execution is not proof of source validity; clear sensitive outputs before publication.

references.title: PROV-O: The PROV Ontology
references.appliesTo: Record source → calculation → validation → reviewer → publication provenance links
references.boundary: Use a small compatible provenance model; avoid adding unnecessary semantic-web infrastructure.

references.title: Open Contracting Data Standard (OCDS)
references.appliesTo: Distinguish procurement, supplier/contractor award, contract changes, implementation and actual payments
references.boundary: Public-sector publication schema as a reference; does not authorize exposing private commercial transactions.

references.title: Configuring GitHub Pages publishing with Actions
references.appliesTo: One validated static publication workflow and explicit visibility boundaries
references.boundary: Pages is static/public; not a secure edit interface or private source-data store.
